name: EPIC 236225368

text.card: A red giant 1,029 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.00 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,539 K at its surface.
